newsitem.title: USA: Andersen Worldwide board names Jim Wadia CEO - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Andersen Worldwide board names Jim Wadia CEO - WSJ.

text.p: The board of accounting and consulting firm Andersen Worldwide has named accounting partner Jim Wadia as its next chief executive officer, the Wall Street Journal said in Tuesday's electronic edition.
The Journal said the board, dominated by accounting partners, decided not to nominate the consulting division's managing partner George Shaheen, who was picked by the firm's nominating committee.
Wadia, 49, is a native of India and has been managing partner of the accounting unit's United Kingdom office since 1993, the newspaper said.
